notes.subject: קסמים
notes.rationale: Diviners: rendered 'ol man i kwasim long posin'; glasman is forbidden by D2 since Lo 18 forbids it and the meaning differs.

notes.subject: ישכל
notes.rationale: Lemma means 'to be silly'; rendered causatively 'em i mekim i kamap nating' — make their knowledge into foolishness.

translation: Em i bagarapim ol tok bilong ol giaman man, na ol man i kwasim long posin em i mekim ol i go longlong; em i kirapim ol man bilong save ol i go bek, na save bilong ol em i mekim i kamap nating.
